title: 第十一章 涂鸦第十二章 大荒诛妖经
slug: 根骨被毁我逆袭成准帝
lines: 却见那奏折上写着，“臣副将周延顿首百拜：伏见前国师南惊尘高徒庄拓，圣王修为，天纵奇才，为国柱石。德配天地，不拘流俗，提携妖族，延揽异才，助我邦国磐石之固。实乃苍生之福，社稷之望。敢乞圣恩，封为国师，以光圣治，臣无任惶悚待命之至，谨奏。”
“不过是一个滥杀无辜，心狠手辣的恶人，竟然夸他德配天地，是苍生之福，社稷之望！还请封他为大昭国师！”
孟婵玥捏紧手里的奏折，心中恨意翻滚：“凭他也配！本公主看他，不过是昭武帝跟前的一条狗！”
这样想着，她朝四周望了一眼，见没有人关注自己，她直接拿起桌上的毛笔，蘸上墨汁，在奏折上画了一条面容丑陋，耳朵旁垂着两条蛇的恶犬。接着又画了一条细细的箭头连到庄拓两个字上。
又在恶犬的头顶写了一行小字，“庄拓是狗，不堪为国师。”
做完这一切，她将笔放回笔架上，又把自己涂抹过的那本奏折放到最下面。
这一夜孟婵玥睡得很安稳，虽然她的所作所为不会对庄拓本人造成什么伤害，但是让他在朝堂上丢一次脸，她也算是讨了一点利息回来。
庄拓并不知晓孟婵玥做的事，这日他像往常一样早早从后殿醒来，穿戴整齐，然后伸手接过鸣秀递过来的三本奏折。
“鸣秀，婵玥这两日可有来找你？”
将外封包着黄缎的奏折捏在手中，庄拓突然问了一句。
鸣秀低垂的眼睫毛轻轻一颤，躬身回道：“回庄圣王，三公主不曾找来。”
“还是不肯服软么！”
庄拓幽幽地说了一句，俊美阴邪的脸上闪过冷意。
“不愧是天潢贵胄，半点自尊都舍弃不下。既然她愿意熬下去，本圣王有的是时间陪她。”
话音落下，他将手里的三本奏折塞入宽大的袖口，抬脚走出观星殿后殿。
今日的朝堂依然分外热闹，阶下的文武大臣争的面红耳赤，讨论五十附属国质子入大昭后的安置问题。有大臣说要将他们拘在鸿胪寺别院防着生事，有人说要将他们散入各学宫教化以显大昭天恩，争吵声震的殿内浮尘在光柱里晃。
庄拓没有插话，他偷偷出列，把袖中的三本奏折递给走下玉阶收奏折的内侍。然后，退回原位，垂眸静立。
龙椅上的昭武帝无聊地撑着额，指尖转着和田玉的扳指，脸上满是倦意。质子安置的议题从辰时扯到巳中，早磨得他失了兴致。直到内侍弯着腰把三本黄缎奏折呈上来，他才懒懒掀开其中一本，扫了两行，原本松垮的肩突然一挺，跟着朗声笑起来。
满朝文武听到昭武帝的笑声，惊得纷纷抬头，你看我我看你，眼睛齐齐往御案方向瞟，连呼吸都放轻了，没人敢先开口问他到底笑什么。
庄拓抬起眼眸，目光扫过昭武帝手中的黄缎封面奏折，俊美阴邪的脸上闪过意外之色。
这奏折似乎是他方才递给内侍的，昭武帝在笑什么？莫非他并不赞成自己当大昭国师？
昭武帝笑完了，将手里的奏折猛地一合，随后朝庄拓看过去。
“庄爱卿，这奏折你呈上来前可曾看过。”
庄拓闻言，面色不由一变。他上前一步，躬身道：“启禀陛下，臣……看过。”
见庄拓如此，昭武帝又忍不住笑起来。
“传朕口谕，即日起，由庄圣王庄拓担任大昭国师，钦天监以后归国师管理。”
“臣谢主隆恩！”
庄拓跪到地上谢恩，他肩膀上的两条青蛇齐齐抬头，盯着昭武帝看。
昭武帝笑着晃晃手里的奏折，说道：“庄国师，这本奏折你拿去看看，就知道朕在笑什么了！”
“退朝！”
文武百官不知道昭武帝到底在笑什么，见散朝后内侍把一本黄缎封面的奏折递给庄拓，都好奇地凑过来。
content_en:
But I saw that the memorial read, "Vice-general Zhou Yandu bowed his head a hundred times: I saw Zhuang Tuo, the former master of the country, Nan Jingchen, a disciple of the sage. He was a holy king and a genius. He was the pillar of the country. His virtue matched the world and he did not follow the customs. Bringing the demon tribe and recruiting talented people to help our country become a rock, it is truly a blessing to the people and the hope of the country. I dare to beg for divine grace and be appointed as a national master to rule with light. I am waiting for orders in fear."
"He is just a ruthless evil man who kills innocent people indiscriminately, but he actually praises him as a man of virtue worthy of heaven and earth. He is a blessing to the people and the hope of the country! Please also make him the Grand Master of Jokhang!"
Meng Chanyue squeezed the memorial in her hand tightly, with hatred boiling in her heart: "He deserves it! From this princess's perspective, he is just a dog in front of Emperor Zhaowu!"
With this thought in mind, she glanced around and saw that no one was paying attention to her. She directly picked up the brush on the table, dipped it in ink, and drew a vicious dog with an ugly face and two snakes hanging next to its ears on the memorial. Then he drew a thin arrow and connected it to the word Zhuang Tuo.
Then he wrote a line of small words on the top of the evil dog's head, "Zhuang Tuo is a dog and cannot be qualified as a national teacher."
After doing all this, she put the pen back on the pen holder and put the memorial she had painted on at the bottom.
Meng Chanyue slept peacefully that night. Although what she did would not cause any harm to Zhuang Tuo himself, she could get some interest back by making him lose face in the court.
Zhuang Tuo didn't know what Meng Chanyue had done. He woke up early from the back hall that day as usual, dressed neatly, and then reached out and took the three memorials handed over by Mingxiu.
"Mingxiu, has Chanyue come to see you these past two days?"
Holding the memorial wrapped in yellow satin in his hands, Zhuang Tuo suddenly asked.
Mingxiu's lowered eyelashes trembled slightly, and she bowed and replied: "Go back to King Zhuang, the third princess never came for you."
"Still unwilling to give in?"
Zhuang Tuo said something quietly, a cold look flashed on his handsome and sinister face.
"As expected of a noble person from Tianhuang, I can't give up even the slightest bit of self-esteem. Since she is willing to endure it, I have plenty of time to spend with her."
After he finished speaking, he stuffed the three memorials in his hand into his wide cuffs and walked out of the back hall of Star Observation Hall.
The court today was still extremely lively, with the civil and military ministers at the lower levels quarreling with red faces as they discussed the placement of the hostages from the fifty vassal countries after they entered Jokhang. Some ministers said that they would be detained in a separate courtyard of Honglu Temple to prevent trouble, while others said that they would be dispersed into various palaces for enlightenment to show the great grace of Heaven. The dust in the temple was shaking in the light pillars as the quarrels were loud.
Zhuang Tuo didn't interrupt. He secretly stepped out of the queue and handed the three memorials in his sleeves to the chamberlain who walked down the jade steps to collect the memorials. Then, he returned to his original position and stood quietly with his eyes lowered.
Emperor Zhaowu on the dragon throne held his forehead in boredom, turning the Hetian jade ring with his fingertips, his face full of tiredness. The issue of proton placement was brought up from Chen Shi to Si Zhong, and he had already lost interest. It wasn't until the chamberlain bent over and presented the three yellow satin memorials that he lazily opened one of them and scanned two lines. His slouched shoulders suddenly straightened up and he laughed loudly.
When the civil and military officials in the court heard Emperor Zhaowu's laughter, they all raised their heads in shock. They looked at me and I looked at you. Their eyes all glanced in the direction of the emperor's case. They even breathed softly. No one dared to ask him what he was laughing about first.
Zhuang Tuo raised his eyes and glanced at the yellow satin-covered memorial in Emperor Zhaowu's hand. A look of surprise flashed across his handsome and sinister face.
It seemed that he had just handed this memorial to his chamberlain. What was Emperor Zhaowu laughing at? Could it be that he did not approve of himself becoming the Great Master of Jokhang?
Emperor Zhaowu finished laughing, slammed the memorial in his hand, and then looked towards Zhuang Tuo.
"Zhuang Aiqing, have you ever read this memorial before submitting it?"
When Zhuang Tuo heard this, his expression changed. He took a step forward, bowed and said, "Your Majesty, I... have seen it."
Seeing Zhuang Tuo like this, Emperor Zhaowu couldn't help but laugh.
"It is my decree that from now on, King Zhuang Sheng, Zhuang Tuo, will serve as the Grand Master of the Dazhao Kingdom. After that, Qin Tianjian will return to the Imperial Master's management."
"I thank you Lord for your kindness!"
Zhuang Tuo knelt on the ground to thank him. The two green snakes on his shoulders raised their heads and stared at Emperor Zhaowu.
Emperor Zhaowu smiled, shook the memorial in his hand, and said, "Master Zhuang, take a look at this memorial and you will know what I am laughing at!"
"Retreat!"
The civil and military officials didn't know what Emperor Zhaowu was laughing about. When the chamberlain handed Zhuang Tuo a memorial with a yellow satin cover after the end of the dynasty, they all came over curiously.
